policy.objective: CE weighted by 1+2*(1-baseline_true_class_score); add 2*KL(baseline||student) only on baseline-correct training examples; teacher frozen
policy.selection: Lowest raw development NLL among eligible EMA epoch checkpoints; otherwise retain baseline
policy.fonts: Pinned train/development/test families; fresh seeds and current-run splits, not a claim of no historical font exposure
policy.inference: Unchanged residual architecture, prepare64 and raw softmax; no score scaling or temperature adjustment
